args.jql: project = PAY AND (text ~ "promo" OR text ~ "Android") ORDER BY updated DESC

args.body:
Investigated production Sentry issue CHECKOUT-WEB-7Q: PromoNotFound for code ' autumn24 ', reported on Android 15 / app android 8.2. The issue links to this ticket.

Implemented the product + mobile agreed fix in the local checkout/promo.py: normalize_code now uses code.strip().replace(" ", "").upper() to strip surrounding whitespace, remove inner spaces, and upper-case before lookup.

Added tests/test_promo.py covering the production example, internal spaces, surrounding whitespace, already-normalized codes, empty/space-only input, punctuation preservation, and idempotency.

Verification: python -m unittest discover -s tests -v — 2 tests passed. Direct reproduction now returns 'AUTUMN24' for ' autumn24 '.

Changes are local only; this workspace has no Git metadata, so no commit/PR was created and nothing has been deployed.
